newsitem.title: USA: Zapata to hire investment adviser.
newsitem.headline: Zapata to hire investment adviser.

text.p: Zapata Corp said Monday its board has authorized the hiring of an investment banking firm to advise it in connection with an acquisition proposal by investor Michael Heisley Sr. and other matters.
Zapata also announced its board has terminated the company's offer to purchase up to 15.0 million common shares at $4.50 a share.

On February 17, Zapata said it received an offer from Heisley in which the investor or a company he controls would acquire any or all, but not less than 50.1 precent, of the outstanding shares of Zapata for $5.50 a share.
